results.description: This is a glass lantern slide which was used to create 'Prestige' hosiery advertising for Sutherland's store in Edendale. Around 1940 General Merchant George Gordon (G.G.) Sutherland purchased Matherson's Ltd on the corner of Ferry and Seaward Roads in Edendale and John McGlinchy's store in Wyndham. He operated these as Sutherland's Stores until 1946 when he sold out to J. Rattray & Sons Ltd. We imagine that this slide was produced to be shown on a projector at the cinema.

Tweedie - Bailey's Book Shop slide - Bailey's Gift Shop slide - Beer and Bailey plumbing slide for sink benches - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slide for wheel alignments - Miss P. Bailey slide for chinaware - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slide for car services - Norman Shields slide for footwear and slippers for men - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slides for the Vanguard Luxury Six car, the Standard vanguard III car, the Standard Vanguard III Vignale car, the Triumph herald E type car, and the standard Vanguard 12-15 cwt Utility car. - McNaughton Motors slides for the Triumph 2000 and Triumph Herald 1200 cars - Robertson's drapers slide for sleep-well mattresses - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slide for Morrison Olympic mowers - Robertson's Drapery slide for Lane's hosiery - McNaughton Garage slide for gas and electric arc welding - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slide for Morrison '62 mower - Riverton Motors Ltd. slide - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slide for the Atlas Major car - Riverton Motors Ltd. slide for regular oiling and greasing - Wright, Stephenson & Coy. Ltd. slide for Leonard Home freezers - Miss P. Bailey slide for books. - Wright, Stephenson & Coy. Ltd. slide for Leonard fridges - George Robertson Ltd. slide for Luxaflex Venetian blinds - McNaughton Bros. Ltd. slide for 'Stanpart' parts - Norman Shields slide for Wellesley shoes - J. B. Magee slide for order wood and coal - D. M. Tweedie slide with what appears to be a roast chicken on proper left of frame - Riverton Motors slide for regular oiling and greasing (blue car variant of ad.) - Riverton Panel Beating Service - slide with upside down green and white car - Riverton Panel Beating Service slide with 'Comes up like new" - Riverton Motors Ltd. yellow tow truck towing red car slide - Riverton Motors Ltd.
